name: @repo/animated-number-input
description: A numeric field with rolling digits, keyboard stepping and horizontal scrub-to-change.

useCases: Quantity field with scrub-to-change and keyboard stepping
Numeric settings input with rolling digit feedback
Currency or unit field with prefix/suffix and precision control
compositionHints: Use in forms alongside animated-input and animated-toggle
Pair with scrubber when a slider-style alternative is also needed
